acceptance: internal/explanationdocs gitio.go treats exec.ErrWaitDelay from a git command that exited 0 as success, the same rule as sysexec.DefaultRunner and gittest
A test makes a git child keep its output pipe open after exit 0 (or a fake runner returns ErrWaitDelay with a 0 exit) and the read succeeds
fix: Accept errors.Is(err, exec.ErrWaitDelay) when cmd.ProcessState.Success(); prefer routing the call through sysexec so one rule holds. Red test first.
summary: MEDIUM: explanationdocs/gitio.go:255 runs git directly and treats exec.ErrWaitDelay as an error. When a forked child inherits the output pipe, a git command that exited 0 can still return ErrWaitDelay; the ship gate then reports 'base SHA is not a commit'. sysexec.DefaultRunner and (since T11-ship) gittest already accept ErrWaitDelay after a successful exit.
title: explanationdocs git reads fail on ErrWaitDelay after a successful exit
